title: Contrastive Covariance Subspaces for Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2610.14025v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Activation steering controls large language model behavior by adding a direction to hidden activations during inference. For steering to work well, that direction must be a pure signal for the target concept: any confound entangled with it, such as an incidental topic or writing style, is injected into the residual stream alongside the concept itself and degrades the generated text. We introduce Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS), a training-free method that eliminates this confound variation. CCS projects steering vectors to a low-dimensional subspace obtained in closed form by solving a contrastive variance objective, which retains the directions along which the target concept varies while suppressing directions shared with the other classes. Across three LLMs and four steering domains, CCS consistently beats all baseline steering methods in all $12$ model-domain settings. The largest relative improvement occurs on AxBench and Emo

translated_title: 用于激活引导的对比协方差子空间
translated_abstract: 激活引导通过在推理过程中向隐藏激活添加一个方向来控制大语言模型的行为。为了使引导有效，该方向必须是目标概念的纯信号：任何与之纠缠的混淆因素，例如偶然的主题或写作风格，都会与概念本身一起被注入残差流，从而降低生成文本的质量。我们提出了对比协方差引导，这是一种无需训练的方法，可以消除这种混淆变化。CCS 将引导向量投影到一个低维子空间，该子空间通过求解对比方差目标以闭式形式获得，保留了目标概念发生变化的方向，同时抑制与其他类别共享的方向。在三个大语言模型和四个引导领域上，CCS 在全部 12 个模型-领域设置中始终优于所有基线引导方法。最大的相对提升出现在 AxBench 和 Emo
tldr: 提出无需训练的对比协方差引导方法，通过将引导向量投影到由对比方差目标闭式求解得到的低维子空间来消除混淆因素，在全部12个模型-领域设置中全面超越现有基线引导方法。
en_tdlr: CCS is a training-free activation steering method that projects steering vectors onto a closed-form low-dimensional subspace derived from a contrastive variance objective, eliminating confounds and outperforming all baselines across all 12 model-domain settings.
